description: This file contains automated test scripts for verifying Perforce ('p4') handling of UTF-16 files without BOM, involving operations such as starting the Perforce server, initializing depot files with UTF-16 encoding, removing BOM, and cloning the depot using git p4.

methods.name: p4 add
methods.description: Adds a file to Perforce depot with specified type.

methods.name: p4d
methods.description: Runs the Perforce server in various modes, including job creation and checkpoint processing.
